ideas.title: One-touch auto-cook puck

new_nodes.label: One-touch auto-cook puck
new_nodes.detail: Single capacitive puck that infers time and power from food type.

ideas.rationale: Removes both timer and power decisions, so the user only presses one button.

ideas.title: Pictogram dial

new_nodes.label: Pictogram detent dial
new_nodes.detail: Single dial with food pictures instead of numbers or power levels.

ideas.rationale: Users choose a picture rather than learn time and power settings.

ideas.title: NFC recipe tag reader

new_nodes.label: NFC meal-tag reader
new_nodes.detail: Reads a tag on ready-meal packaging to set power automatically.

ideas.rationale: Power level is set by the meal itself, eliminating the power knob.

ideas.title: Offline voice intent chip

new_nodes.label: Offline voice intent recognition
new_nodes.detail: Tiny chip recognises phrases like 'two minutes' without cloud or setup.

new_nodes.label: Voice-control microphone module
new_nodes.detail: Single mic and chip replace the timer knob.

ideas.rationale: The user says a simple time instead of learning a timer knob.

ideas.title: Steam sensor stop

new_nodes.label: Steam/humidity stop sensor
new_nodes.detail: Detects when food is steaming hot and stops automatically.

ideas.rationale: No timer setting is needed because the microwave knows when to stop.

ideas.title: IR thermometer power

new_nodes.label: IR surface-temperature sensor
new_nodes.detail: Non-contact sensor sets power to reach a safe target temperature.

ideas.rationale: Removes the power-level decision by adjusting power automatically.

ideas.title: Voice announcement

new_nodes.label: Tiny voice announcement speaker
new_nodes.detail: Spoken 'done' replaces the mechanical bell.

ideas.rationale: A clear spoken signal is easier to understand than a generic ding.

ideas.title: Transparent OLED window

new_nodes.label: Transparent OLED door panel
new_nodes.detail: See-through display lets users watch food without an internal lamp.

ideas.rationale: The user just looks through the door, with no lamp or mesh-window learning.

ideas.title: Camera plus exterior display

new_nodes.label: Internal cavity camera
new_nodes.detail: Camera views food and sends image to an exterior screen.

new_nodes.label: Exterior view screen
new_nodes.detail: Shows the food clearly without a perforated window.

ideas.rationale: Replaces the lamp and holes with a simple screen view.

ideas.title: Mode stirrer replaces turntable

new_nodes.label: Rotating mode stirrer
new_nodes.detail: Hidden metal fan rotates the field instead of the food.

ideas.rationale: Users no longer need to align or clean a turntable.

ideas.title: Magnetic latch pull handle

new_nodes.label: Magnetic pull-latch handle
new_nodes.detail: Door opens by pulling a simple handle, no push-button needed.

ideas.rationale: A familiar pull-handle action removes the separate door-release button.

ideas.title: Hall-effect door sensor

new_nodes.label: Hall-effect door sensor
new_nodes.detail: Solid-state magnetic sensor replaces three interlock microswitches.

ideas.rationale: Fewer mechanical switches mean less fiddly door behaviour for users.

ideas.title: NFC tap-to-cook

new_nodes.label: NFC tap-to-cook pad
new_nodes.detail: Tap a phone or tag to start a preset cook cycle.

ideas.rationale: Cooking starts from a tap instead of manually setting time and power.

ideas.title: Binary less/more button

new_nodes.label: Less/More doneness button
new_nodes.detail: Two buttons adjust a single doneness scale automatically.

ideas.rationale: Replaces five power levels with an intuitive less/more choice.

ideas.title: Detented single encoder

new_nodes.label: Detented time encoder
new_nodes.detail: Each click adds 30 seconds, with no numeric display needed.

ideas.rationale: Clicks map directly to time increments, so no timer reading is needed.

ideas.title: Five colour-coded buttons

new_nodes.label: Colour-coded preset buttons
new_nodes.detail: Thaw, reheat, cook, boil, melt buttons replace the power knob.

ideas.rationale: Users pick a familiar activity instead of learning duty-cycle power levels.

ideas.title: Probe thermometer start-only

new_nodes.label: Food probe thermometer
new_nodes.detail: Cooks until the food reaches a safe target temperature; only Start is pressed.

ideas.rationale: The microwave ends cooking by itself, so no time or power setting is needed.

ideas.title: Big add-30-seconds button

new_nodes.label: Giant add-30s button
new_nodes.detail: One large button adds 30 seconds per press and starts instantly.

ideas.rationale: A single oversized button is self-explanatory for short reheats.

ideas.title: Foot pedal door release

new_nodes.label: Foot-pedal door release
new_nodes.detail: Tap a pedal to open the door when hands are full.

ideas.rationale: Hands-free opening is intuitive when carrying food or dishes.

ideas.title: Load-cell turntable

new_nodes.label: Load-cell weighing turntable
new_nodes.detail: Weighs food and calculates cooking time automatically.

ideas.rationale: Users place food and press start; weight sets the time for them.

ideas.title: Barcode scanner

new_nodes.label: Barcode scanner
new_nodes.detail: Scans package barcodes to look up power and time presets.

ideas.rationale: The package tells the microwave how to cook, avoiding manual power setting.

ideas.title: IR gesture sensor

new_nodes.label: IR gesture control sensor
new_nodes.detail: Wave hand to start, stop, or add time.

ideas.rationale: A simple wave replaces knob turning and button learning.

ideas.title: AI camera zero controls

new_nodes.label: Food-recognition AI vision
new_nodes.detail: Camera recognises food and chooses cook program.

new_nodes.label: Door-mounted food camera
new_nodes.detail: Sees the cavity contents before cooking.

ideas.rationale: The microwave recognises food and decides everything, leaving almost no interface.

ideas.title: RGB LED ring alert

new_nodes.label: RGB LED status ring
new_nodes.detail: Turns green and pulses when cooking is done.

ideas.rationale: A colour change is instantly understood without learning an alert sound.

ideas.title: LED strip interior light

new_nodes.label: Low-voltage LED strip
new_nodes.detail: Long-life LED strip replaces the incandescent lamp.

ideas.rationale: Reliable illumination means users never need to replace a lamp to see food.

ideas.title: Hydrophobic mesh waveguide cover

new_nodes.label: Hydrophobic self-cleaning waveguide mesh
new_nodes.detail: Repels grease and can be wiped clean, replacing mica.

ideas.rationale: No delicate mica cover to clean or replace, simplifying maintenance.

ideas.title: Rotating mode stirrer antenna

new_nodes.label: Rotating antenna stirrer
new_nodes.detail: Motorised antenna rotates the microwave field without a turntable.

ideas.rationale: No turntable to align, so users can place any dish anywhere.

ideas.title: Beverage weight-temp preset

new_nodes.label: Beverage weight-temp sensor
new_nodes.detail: Detects mug weight and initial temperature to heat drinks safely.

ideas.rationale: Hot drinks become one-button safe operations with no settings.

ideas.title: Tactile symbols only

new_nodes.label: Tactile symbol fascia
new_nodes.detail: Raised icons and words replace all numeric labels.

ideas.rationale: Users can feel and recognise functions without reading a manual.

ideas.title: Pico projector countdown

new_nodes.label: Pico projector countdown
new_nodes.detail: Projects remaining time onto the countertop or wall.

ideas.rationale: Time is visible where the user looks, removing the need to decode a knob.

ideas.title: Transparent RF-shielding film

new_nodes.label: Transparent RF-shielding film
new_nodes.detail: See-through conductive film blocks microwaves while letting light pass.

ideas.rationale: A clear window plus no lamp makes watching food effortless.

ideas.title: Acoustic popcorn sensor

new_nodes.label: Acoustic popcorn sensor
new_nodes.detail: Listens to popping rate and stops at the right moment.

ideas.rationale: The user just presses popcorn; the machine listens and stops itself.

ideas.title: Voice-operated door

new_nodes.label: Voice-operated door actuator
new_nodes.detail: Says 'open' and the door pops open automatically.

ideas.rationale: Eliminates the physical door button for users with limited dexterity.

ideas.title: Doneness dial

new_nodes.label: Doneness dial
new_nodes.detail: Dial marked rare/medium/done rather than minutes.

ideas.rationale: Users choose a doneness outcome instead of calculating cooking time.

ideas.title: Temperature-target dial

new_nodes.label: Temperature-target dial
new_nodes.detail: Dial shows 40°C, 60°C, 80°C targets instead of power levels.

ideas.rationale: Power is abstract; temperature targets are understandable to anyone.

ideas.title: One-button state machine

new_nodes.label: One-button cycling controller
new_nodes.detail: Quick presses cycle through presets; long press starts.

ideas.rationale: A single button replaces both knobs and has no wrong mode.

ideas.title: Proximity sensor start

new_nodes.label: Touchless proximity sensor
new_nodes.detail: Door opens and cooking starts when a hand approaches.

ideas.rationale: No button to find or press, which is simpler for messy hands.

ideas.title: QR-code cook scanner

new_nodes.label: QR-code cook scanner
new_nodes.detail: Scans package QR codes to load cooking instructions.

ideas.rationale: The package supplies time and power, so the user does nothing but scan.

ideas.title: Weight dial

new_nodes.label: Weight-based time dial
new_nodes.detail: Dial selects food weight; time is calculated automatically.

ideas.rationale: Users set grams, not minutes, which is a familiar food quantity.

ideas.title: Auto-defrost sensor

new_nodes.label: Auto-defrost sensor
new_nodes.detail: Detects ice/water phase change and controls defrost power.

ideas.rationale: Defrost becomes a single automatic mode instead of a manual power setting.

ideas.title: Vibration motor alert

new_nodes.label: Vibration pulse alert motor
new_nodes.detail: Silent vibration pulses signal completion instead of a bell.

ideas.rationale: A tactile cue is easy to notice and needs no sound interpretation.

ideas.title: Phosphorescent cavity lining

new_nodes.label: Phosphorescent cavity lining
new_nodes.detail: Glow-in-the-dark lining stores light and glows during cooking.

ideas.rationale: Cavity glows without a bulb, so there is no lamp to replace or switch.

ideas.title: Two-button interface

new_nodes.label: Start and More only interface
new_nodes.detail: Two buttons: Start and More. Everything else is automatic.

ideas.rationale: Two obvious buttons create almost no learning curve.

ideas.title: Colour-changing thermal paint doneness

new_nodes.label: Thermochromic doneness strip
new_nodes.detail: Strip changes colour as food heats, so cooking can stop automatically.

ideas.rationale: The food itself signals doneness, removing the need to set time.

ideas.title: Five-minute max timer

new_nodes.label: Five-minute single-turn timer
new_nodes.detail: Timer only goes 0-5 minutes, covering most reheats.

ideas.rationale: A shorter, simpler timer range avoids the confusing 30-minute dial.

ideas.title: Always-two-minutes reheat

new_nodes.label: Fixed two-minute reheat button
new_nodes.detail: One button always runs a safe default reheat cycle.

ideas.rationale: Most reheats need no settings; one button covers a common case.

ideas.title: Reheat-only power button

new_nodes.label: Reheat-only power button
new_nodes.detail: Single dedicated button sets the ideal reheating power.

ideas.rationale: The most common power level is preselected, so users do not choose.

ideas.title: Single-switch interlock with fuse

new_nodes.label: Single robust door switch
new_nodes.detail: One rugged switch plus fuse replaces three microswitches.

ideas.rationale: Less mechanical complexity means the door simply works every time.

ideas.title: Three-icon cook dial

new_nodes.label: Three-icon cook dial
new_nodes.detail: Only three positions: reheat, defrost, cook. All else automatic.

ideas.rationale: Three familiar icons replace two knobs and five power levels.
